title: Comfort Club Seasonal Upkeep and the Replacement System Installations Contract Deposit
content:
# Seasonal-upkeep multiplier on the contract deposit

## Rule

The seasonal-upkeep factor of a Replacement System Installations contract deposit counts only tune-up visits completed on the homeowner's Comfort Club agreement, never a visit forfeited for a missed or late-cancelled appointment, and counts them in one of three ways:

- for an agreement in active status billed annually, the completed tune-up visits of its current agreement term, from its term start;
- for an agreement in active status billed monthly, the completed tune-up visits in the 12 months before the date of handling;
- for a homeowner with no agreement in active status, no visits are counted and the multiplier is 1.0.

On that count, 4 or more completed visits multiply the percentage deposit by 0.85, at least 2 but fewer than 4 multiply it by 0.92, and fewer than 2 keep 1.0.

The agreement's status, dues billing, term start and visit history are read from the Comfort Club Maintenance Agreements records.

## Counting method

| Agreement | Visits counted |
|---|---|
| Active, dues billed annually | Completed tune-ups of the current term, from its term start |
| Active, dues billed monthly | Completed tune-ups in the 12 months before the date of handling |
| Not in active status, or none | None — multiplier 1.0 |

## Count to multiplier

| Completed tune-up visits counted | Multiplier on the percentage deposit |
|---|---|
| 4 or more | 0.85 |
| 2 or 3 | 0.92 |
| 0 or 1 | 1.0 |

## Cases (hypothetical agreements)

- Active, billed annually, current term started 7 months ago with 2 completed tune-ups in it and 3 more in the previous term: 2 counted — 0.92.
- Active, billed monthly, 4 completed tune-ups in the last 12 months: 0.85.
- Active, billed monthly, 2 completed tune-ups and 1 forfeited visit in the last 12 months: 2 counted — 0.92.
- Lapsed agreement with 5 completed tune-ups last year: no count — 1.0.
